After a surah ends, the next one starts
The recitation streams over the internet and is not stored on the phone: about 60 MB per hour of listening.
You can choose a recording on your phone (for example, adhkar recited by Sheikh Mishary Alafasy that you own) instead of the phone voice.
Add a file from the phone

An audio file with chapters (for example Hisn al-Muslim in one file): in the car it shows as a list of parts, next and previous move between parts, and the listening position is saved. The file stays on your phone and is not uploaded anywhere.
Remove from the library (the file stays on the phone)

Pages follow the Madani mushaf (604 pages). Audio is streamed verse by verse from everyayah.com and kept on the phone, so repeats and the next listen need no data. When a session ends the plan moves on to the next page. In the car: next and previous change the page.
Shown only while the car is stopped
Shown only while the car is stopped
The car does not report its speed and the phone has no GPS fix yet, so a stop cannot be confirmed
Not available while the video is re-encoded
Available once the car screen is connected
Silences longer than 1.5 seconds become under a second; normal pauses in the recitation stay. Turn it off for the teaching mushaf if you want time to repeat after the reciter.

The mushaf shows on the car screen only while the car is stopped (including at traffic lights). Your car does not report its speed, so HOG uses the phone GPS. Allow location «All the time» for HOG CarLink: Permissions → Location → Allow all the time.
For a passenger reading along with the reciter
The mushaf will stay on the car screen while the car is moving. It is meant for a passenger. The driver must keep his eyes on the road.
